title: OmniBounty V3 Acceptance Criteria
description: Normative shape of a V3 bounty criteria document. The funded document is canonicalized per docs/v3/CANONICALIZATION.md and committed on-chain as criteria_hash = keccak256(canonical_bytes). No defaults exist in canonical form: authoring tooling MUST materialize every field before funding, and anything not in this schema is REJECTED (additionalProperties:false everywhere), so a typo can never silently disable a criterion. Numbers do not exist in this format: every integer is a canonical decimal string, no leading zeros.

base_commit.description: Optional. When present, the PR's base.sha MUST equal it exactly.

merge_policy.description: 'merged' requires extracted merged==true. 'ci_verified' imposes no merged constraint (merged PRs with green CI also qualify).

allow_forks.description: Required, no default. false => PR head repo MUST equal criteria repo. true => fork heads permitted (base repo still pinned).

author_association.description: Optional allowlist. When present, the PR author's association MUST be a member.

identity_policy.description: 'open': first valid prover is paid; GitHub author is evidence/display only (honest limitation, see SECURITY_MODEL.md). 'commitment': PR title/body MUST contain 'omnibounty:<bounty_id>:<recipient>' where recipient equals the proof owner (branch-write access binds author to payout address).

required.description: Each entry needs >=1 completed+success run on the PR head from an allowed app slug. Semantics are existential per entry.

max_age_sec.description: Optional. When present and nonzero, each qualifying run's completed_at must be within this many seconds before the claim (u64 range enforced by validator; 0/absent = no limit).

allowed_paths.description: Optional. Every changed path MUST match >=1 entry, else the claim fails.

forbidden_paths.description: Optional. No changed path may match any entry.

required_touched.description: Optional. Every entry must match >=1 changed path.

protected.description: Optional. Each file's blob SHA at the PR head (contents API) MUST equal the committed blob SHA. Positive equality only — never absence reasoning.

patch_contains_all.description: Optional. Every string must occur in the PR unified diff (Accept-pinned diff proof, one contains matcher each).

required_approvals.description: Each listed login MUST have state APPROVED (anchored reviewer->state binding). Bare approval COUNTS are deliberately unsupported (not robustly countable via first-match regex).

url.description: Must be https://github.com/<criteria.repo>/(issues|pull)/<number>; repo part validated semantically.

issue.description: When require_close_reference is true, PR title/body MUST contain '<keyword> #<N>' for >=1 keyword (single alternation matcher). The URL alone is always display + link only.

policy.description: Declared winner policy. Must be consistent with slots length (single_winner <=> exactly 1 slot); inconsistency is an invalid-allocation error.

amount.description: USDC base units (6 decimals), canonical decimal string, MUST be > 0. Equal vs weighted allocation is expressed by making amounts equal vs different — there is no separate mode that could disagree with the money.

slots.description: Slot i pays slots[i].amount to the i-th qualifier in deterministic qualification order. sum(slots) MUST equal the funded escrow total (checked at funding time on-chain).

unfilled.description: Unfilled slot funds return to the sponsor after expiry. Single allowed value today; reserved for future policies (e.g. rollover).

deadline.description: Unix seconds; 0 = no deadline. Claims at/after a nonzero deadline are rejected.

challenge_window_sec.description: Seconds between qualification and finalization; 0 = finalize immediately. During the window anyone may submit deterministic counter-evidence; there is no voting and no judge.

evidence_max_age_sec.description: Max proof age at submit, seconds; MUST be <= 604800 (protocol ceiling, enforced semantically). Required explicitly — no hidden default in canonical form.

uint_str.description: Canonical non-negative integer: decimal digits, no leading zeros, no sign, no whitespace. u64 range (<= 18446744073709551615) enforced semantically.

exact_path.description: Exact repo-relative path: no leading/trailing slash, no empty segments (segment check is semantic).

path_pattern.description: Exact path, or dir/ subtree prefix when ending in '/'. No leading slash, no empty segments, no glob metacharacters except the trailing-slash convention (enforced semantically).
